name: @noesar/spoken-intent
description: Resolving what a person said against a registry of things a product can do: normalisation with accent folding, injected filler, an eight-rank exact-or-containing ladder with no fuzzy matching anywhere, uniqueness by destination, trailing-argument capture, and additive compound splitting. Extracted from NOESAR EVOLUTION's voice layer — the product's entry shape, its sentences and its languages deliberately stay out.
